reading_note: The teaching describes the complete arc by which the operative divine power (Living Spirit) constructs the spiritual cosmos in seven discrete stages: (1) rescue of divine truth from its captivity in the realm of self-love; (2) distribution of that truth, clothed in ultimates, into every form of life; (3) the binding of the substances of evil; (4) establishment of the vehicles of truth (sun and moon as ships of light = celestial and spiritual goods carrying souls home); (5) the five sons who bear the cosmic order = the five discrete degrees of reception sustaining all things, with three living words set against the moulds of falsity; (6) establishment of the Zone — the circuit of spiritual states — peopled with powers and angels who govern its rotation until the work is completed and gathered into storehouses and watch-places; (7) the final work, the manifestation of the glorious image at the consummation, when all evils are bound and the whole is raised into the Aeons of the new heaven, where stands the tree of glory and joy. The arc moves from rescue → distribution → binding of evil → establishment of vehicles → ordering by degrees → governance of the cycle → final manifestation and ascent.
